Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper instance for a binary search specification named BinSearch3, with all parameters fixed locally. It sets the integer width to 8 bits, fixes the input sequence to the empty sequence << >>, fixes the search key to 10, and declares the state variables low, high, isTerminated, and returnValue that are intended to be used by the instantiated specification. The file itself does not define any actions, temporal specification, or properties; instead, it serves only as a parameterized shell around the external BinSearch3 module.
